items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: David Jones, Joe Ruscio, Manny Sills, all of them, they get different names.

ctx.x: Yeah. But where did you get the names for those numbers? Huh? Where did you get the names for those numbers?
Well, the different fellas pick out the names. You know, they get the names. David Jones, Joe Ruscio, Manny Sills, all of them, they get different names.
What does Tip Easy mean? Huh? What does Tip Easy mean when you call it the Tip Easy Blues?
